text: {"quantities":[{"id":"q1","value":232,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"232 pieces"},{"id":"q2","value":54,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"54 red candies"},{"id":"q3","value":2,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"twice that amount of orange candies"},{"id":"q4","value":2,"unit":"","kind":"count","span":"half as many yellow candies as red candies"}],"plan":[{"op":"mul","args":["q2","q3"],"out":"s1","note":"orange candies are twice the red count: multiply red (54) by 2"},{"op":"div","args":["q2","q4"],"out":"s2","note":"yellow candies are half the red count: divide red (54) by 2"},{"op":"add","args":["q2","s1"],"out":"s3","note":"add red and orange counts together"},{"op":"add","args":["s3","s2"],"out":"s4","note":"add yellow count to the running red+orange total"},{"op":"sub","args":["q1","s4"],"out":"s5","note":"subtract red+orange+yellow from the total bag count to find how many are pink"}],"target":{"kind":"count","scope":"number of pink candies in the bag"},"dismissed":[]}
